definitions.explanation: The outward look or style of something or someone.
Being proper or fitting for a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{格好|かっこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: Are you going out dressed like that?

{格好|かっこう}⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{格好|かっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：02885_sanpo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格好|かっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: The rain stopped and it became perfect weather for going out.

notes:
{格好|かっこう} has two main uses: describing outward appearance/attire (noun) and meaning suitable or ideal (na-adjective).

SENSE 1 — APPEARANCE:
Refers to how someone looks, especially their clothing or posture.
- {格好|かっこう}⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/かっこ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: cool, stylish
- {格好|かっこう}⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧/かっこ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: uncool, lame, embarrassing
- {格好|かっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to try to look cool, to put on airs
- ⟦{変|へん}な→変：01124_hen⟧{格好|かっこう}: strange outfit/appearance

SENSE 2 — SUITABLE:
Used as a na-adjective meaning ideal or appropriate for a purpose.
- {格好|かっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: ideal spot
- {格好|かっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: perfect opportunity
- {格好|かっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧: easy target

WRITING:
Also written as {恰好|かっこう} (older kanji) or in hiragana. Often shortened to かっこ in casual speech: かっこ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧, かっこ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: figure, form (more literary)
- ⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧: attire, dress (specifically clothing)
- ⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧: outward appearance, looks
